operations.summary: Run prepared univariable MR, conditional MVMR, a complete two-exposure scan across a fixed outcome panel, or complete-region coloc in the persistent R queue. The panel scan runs two MR estimates and one MVMR contrast per outcome, validates complete coverage and emits TSV summaries. Inputs must be prepared summary statistics; GWAS retrieval and LD clumping are not provided. Results are retrieved with r.get.job.manifest and r_files. Requires confirm=true.
operations.output: Submission with remote identifier; status and manifest are separate operations.
